title: The Sunday Read: ‘My Miserable Week in the “Happiest Country on Earth’’’

sentences.en: 33 presidents.
sentences.zh: 33位总统。

sentences.en: I called the president at 4.30 in the morning and he answered.
sentences.zh: 我在早上4点半给总统打了电话，他接了。

sentences.en: Seven decades in space.
sentences.zh: 在太空的七十年。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗星星的背后是什么。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.
sentences.zh: 上千份消费品指南。

sentences.en: Today I am testing seven mattresses.
sentences.zh: 今天我在测试七张床垫。

sentences.en: 60 super sundaes.
sentences.zh: 60个超级圣代冰淇淋。

sentences.en: They were probably the best team in the league every single year.
sentences.zh: 他们可能每年都是联赛里最好的球队。

sentences.en: 53,500 puzzles.
I use a different starting word every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天都用一个不同的首字母单词。

sentences.en: 25,000 recipes.
And I love a one-pan recipe because I don't love washing pans.
sentences.zh: 而且我很喜欢一锅出菜谱，因为我讨厌洗锅。

sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》，庆祝175周年，陪伴您理解世界并充分过好每一天。

sentences.en: Subscribe now for a special offer at nytimes.com slash subscribe.
sentences.zh: 立即订阅，享受nytimes.com/subscribe上的特惠。

sentences.en: Hi, my name is Molly Young.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我叫莫莉·扬。

sentences.en: I'm a book critic at The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的一名书评人。

sentences.en: Since 2012, the UN-backed World Happiness Report has put out an annual ranking of countries.
sentences.zh: 自2012年以来，联合国支持的《世界幸福报告》每年都会发布一份国家排名。

sentences.en: For the past eight years, Finland has been at the top of the leaderboard, sitting at number one.
sentences.zh: 在过去的八年里，芬兰一直稳居排行榜榜首，占据第一的位置。

sentences.en: In fact, Nordic countries dominate all the top spots, which makes Finland's victory streak even more remarkable.
sentences.zh: 事实上，北欧国家占据了所有领先地位，这使得芬兰的连胜纪录更加引人注目。

sentences.en: The U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国

sentences.en: came in at number 24 in the most recent report released in March of this year, ranking just below the U.K.
sentences.zh: 在今年3月发布的最新报告中排名第24位，刚好排在英国后面。

sentences.en: I'd already been to Iceland, number three, and Costa Rica, number six, as well as a few of the other countries that beat out the U.S.
sentences.zh: 我以前去过排名第三的冰岛和排名第六的哥斯达黎加，以及今年排名中

sentences.en: on this year's ranking.
sentences.zh: 击败美国的其他几个国家。

sentences.en: And when I found out that The New York Times magazine was going to put out an issue devoted to happiness, I pitched going to Finland to see how the Finns define happiness, and of
sentences.zh: 当我发现《纽约时报》杂志将出一期专刊探讨幸福时，我便提议去芬兰看看芬兰人是如何定义幸福的，当然，

sentences.en: course, how they achieve it.
sentences.zh: 还有他们是如何实现幸福的。

sentences.en: But I wanted to test Finland in the dead of winter, at what I presume to be its lowest point.
sentences.zh: 但我想在严冬的严寒中考验芬兰，也就是我猜想它最落魄的时候。

sentences.en: I would test Finland on hard mode.
sentences.zh: 我要在困难模式下考验芬兰。

sentences.en: So here's my article, read by Julia Whelan.
sentences.zh: 这是我的文章，由茱莉亚·韦兰朗读。

sentences.en: Our audio producer today is Tali Abacassus.
sentences.zh: 我们今天的音频制作人是塔利·阿巴卡苏斯。

sentences.en: And the music you'll hear was written and performed by Aaron Esposito.
sentences.zh: 你将听到的音乐由亚伦·埃斯波西托创作和演奏。

sentences.en: Thanks for listening.
sentences.zh: 感谢收听。

sentences.en: Coming to Helsinki in February is an objectively weird choice, said a man named Mikko Tironen.
sentences.zh: “二月份来赫尔辛基是一个客观上很奇怪的选择，”一个叫米科·蒂罗宁的男人说。

sentences.en: During this time, we don't have, he paused, colors.
sentences.zh: “在这段时期，我们没有，”他停顿了一下，“色彩。”

sentences.en: I was sitting in a coffee shop with Tironen, a web developer and writer, after flying to
sentences.zh: 我和蒂罗宁坐在一间咖啡馆里，他是一名网页开发者兼作家，此前我飞往

sentences.en: Helsinki to think about happiness.
sentences.zh: 赫尔辛基来思考幸福。

sentences.en: For eight years running, Finland has been rated the happiest country in the world by a peculiar
sentences.zh: 连续八年，芬兰都被一个名为《世界幸福报告》的奇特

sentences.en: United Nations-backed project called the World Happiness Report, started in 2012.
sentences.zh: 联合国支持项目评为世界上最幸福的国家，该项目始于2012年。

sentences.en: Soon after Finland shot to the top of the list, its government set up a happiness tourism
sentences.zh: 在芬兰跃居榜首后不久，其政府就建立了一个幸福旅游

sentences.en: initiative, which now offers itineraries highlighting the cultural elements that ostensibly contribute to its status.
sentences.zh: 倡议，现在该倡议提供行程，重点介绍据称促成其地位的文化元素。

sentences.en: Foraging, fresh air, trees, lakes, sustainably produced meals, and, perhaps above all else, saunas.
sentences.zh: 采摘、新鲜空气、树木、湖泊、可持续生产的餐食，或许最重要的是，桑拿。

sentences.en: Instead of adhering to one of these optimal itineraries or visiting Finland at the rosiest time of year, any time except the dead of winter, I'd come to Tironen's bafflement
sentences.zh: 我没有选择这些最佳行程之一，也没有在一年中最美好的时期（除了严冬之外的任何时间）访问芬兰，而是在蒂罗宁的困惑中

sentences.en: with few plans at all during one of the bleakest months.
sentences.zh: 在其中一个最阴暗的月份里，带着几乎毫无计划的行程来到了这里。

sentences.en: Would the happiest country on earth still be so mirthful at its gloomiest?
sentences.zh: 世界上最幸福的国家在它最阴郁的时候还会这么快乐吗？

sentences.en: When I explained this, Tironen recalled a quote by the Finnish author Joka Vikela that goes,
sentences.zh: 当我解释这一点时，蒂罗宁想起了芬兰作家约卡·维凯拉的一句名言：

sentences.en: Finland is a land where children play in darkness.
sentences.zh: “芬兰是一个孩子们在黑暗中玩耍的国度。”

sentences.en: The quote was both a metaphor and a descriptive statement, he suggested.
sentences.zh: 他暗示，这句话既是一个隐喻，也是一种描述性陈述。

sentences.en: Because of the country's global coordinates, Finnish kids do indeed play in the dark a lot.
sentences.zh: 由于该国的全球坐标，芬兰孩子们确实有很多时间在黑暗中玩耍。

sentences.en: To avoid being struck by vehicles, they clip decorative reflectors called heiestine to their coats.
sentences.zh: 为了避免被车辆撞到，他们在外套上夹了名为“heiestine”的装饰性反光贴。

sentences.en: The reflectors come in all shapes, lemon, poodle, swan, hedgehog, soccer ball.
sentences.zh: 这些反光贴形状各异，有柠檬、贵宾犬、天鹅、刺猬、足球。

sentences.en: Adults wear them too.
sentences.zh: 成年人也戴着它们。

sentences.en: I joke that going outside without my reflector is a way of inviting suicide, Tironen said.
sentences.zh: “我开玩笑说，出门不带反光贴简直是自杀行为，”蒂罗宁说。

sentences.en: If it happens, it happens.
sentences.zh: “如果发生了，那就发生了。”

sentences.en: We were both drinking from small coffee cups, which are prevalent in Finland.
sentences.zh: 我们都在用芬兰很常见的小咖啡杯喝着咖啡。

sentences.en: Anyone wanting more than a thimble full of coffee had to pursue refills relentlessly.
sentences.zh: 任何想要超过一小口咖啡的人都必须不停地续杯。

sentences.en: Tironen took a sip, emptying his cup.
sentences.zh: 蒂罗宁喝了一口，喝光了杯子里的咖啡。

sentences.en: My partner does not like this joke.
sentences.zh: “我的伴侣不喜欢这个玩笑。”

sentences.en: My own happiness experiment was off to a poor start.
sentences.zh: 我自己的幸福实验开局不利。

sentences.en: I arrived the day before, a Sunday afternoon, in a capsule of germs, a packed plane vibrating with the sounds of coughing and phlegm management.
sentences.zh: 我前一天下午到达，那是一个周日，身处一个充满细菌的“胶囊”中，这架拥挤的飞机上嗡嗡作响，充斥着咳嗽声和清理痰液的声音。

sentences.en: Monday dawned in sickness and jet lag.
sentences.zh: 星期一伴随着疾病和时差破晓。

sentences.en: I dressed and left my icy little hotel room, stopping at a chain store called Normal, completely
sentences.zh: 我穿好衣服，离开了我那冰冷的小酒店房间，在一家名为Normal的连锁店停下，这里以

sentences.en: normal goods at fixed low prices, for a bag of the region's signature treat, salty licorice.
sentences.zh: 固定低价出售完全正常的商品，我买了一袋当地的标志性零食——咸甘草糖。

sentences.en: Helsinki wore a hat of fog.
sentences.zh: 赫尔辛基戴着一顶雾气帽子。

sentences.en: You could see roughly thirty feet in the air before all was concealed behind a pearly scrim.
sentences.zh: 你只能看清大约三十英尺高的空中，之后一切都被掩盖在珍珠般的薄纱后面。

sentences.en: After coffee with Tironen, I went for an evening walk to the harbor, where black slicks of water twinkled between frozen flows.
sentences.zh: 和蒂罗宁喝完咖啡后，我傍晚去海港散步，冰层之间闪烁着黑色的水痕。

sentences.en: The stands that sold salmon soup and hot dogs during the day were closed.
sentences.zh: 白天出售三文鱼汤和热狗的摊位都关门了。

sentences.en: It was frosty and sparse.
sentences.zh: 这里寒冷而冷清。

sentences.en: Families walked together and ate in dimly lit restaurants.
sentences.zh: 一家人结伴散步，在昏暗的餐厅里用餐。

sentences.en: Helsinki's famous esplanade was empty.
sentences.zh: 赫尔辛基著名的林荫大道空无一人。

sentences.en: In spring, the central walkway becomes a riot of flowering crab apples and bare shoulders,
sentences.zh: 我被告知，到了春天，中央步道会开满繁茂的盛开海棠花，人们也光着膀子，

sentences.en: I had been told, but now the kiosks were shuttered, the trees skeletal, the paths plowed but untrodden.
sentences.zh: 但现在售货亭都关门了，树木光秃秃的，小路虽然被铲雪车清理过，却无人踩踏。

sentences.en: I stopped at a bar for a drink and felt worse after finishing it, as I knew I would, given alcohol's peerless capacity to italicize whatever mood the drinker is already in.
sentences.zh: 我在一家酒吧停下来喝一杯，喝完后感觉更糟糕了，正如我所料，因为酒精有一种无与伦比的能力，能为饮酒者当时的心情加上着重号。

sentences.en: On the way back to the hotel, I thought about something Tironen mentioned earlier.
sentences.zh: 在回酒店的路上，我想起了蒂罗宁之前提到的一件事。

sentences.en: Outside his apartment, he said, there stood a hideous mound of dirty snow streaked in mud and gravel.
sentences.zh: 他说，在他公寓外面，堆着一堆丑陋的脏雪，夹杂着泥土和碎石。

sentences.en: He and his partner had joked about sending me a photograph of the mound as a pre-souvenir, a sardonic,
sentences.zh: 他和他的伴侣曾开玩笑说要给我发一张这堆雪的照片作为“准纪念品”，带着讽刺意味的

sentences.en: Welcome to Finland.
sentences.zh: “欢迎来到芬兰”。

sentences.en: There are obvious problems with measuring happiness.
sentences.zh: 衡量幸福存在显而易见的问题。

sentences.en: Despite thousands of years of inquiry, nobody, from Confucius to Aristotle to Jeremy Bentham to Richard Easterlin to Oprah Winfrey can agree on what happiness is.
sentences.zh: 尽管经过了数千年的探究，从孔子到亚里士多德、杰里米·边沁、理查德·伊斯特林到奥普拉·温弗瑞，没有人能就什么是幸福达成一致。

sentences.en: Is it a quantum of pleasure?
sentences.zh: 幸福是一定数量的快乐吗？

sentences.en: The absence of pain?
sentences.zh: 痛苦的缺席？

sentences.en: A perception of purpose?
sentences.zh: 对目标感知的觉察？

sentences.en: Hope?
sentences.zh: 希望？

sentences.en: Community?
sentences.zh: 社区？

sentences.en: How does it relate to health or wealth or income?
sentences.zh: 它与健康、财富或收入有何关系？

sentences.en: Is happiness a mood?
sentences.zh: 幸福是一种心情吗？

sentences.en: A neurotransmitter?
sentences.zh: 一种神经递质？

sentences.en: The first World Happiness Report was a 170-page PDF with a chart that ranked countries by happiness.
sentences.zh: 第一份《世界幸福报告》是一份170页的PDF，里面有一个按幸福程度给国家排名的图表。

sentences.en: Denmark came in first, Finland second, Norway third.
sentences.zh: 丹麦排名第一，芬兰第二，挪威第三。

sentences.en: The United States was number 11.
sentences.zh: 美国排名第11。

sentences.en: Since then, a new scorecard has been issued nearly every year.
sentences.zh: 自那以后，几乎每年都会发布一份新的记分卡。

sentences.en: The rankings are based on a single question from which a huge amount, an insane amount, is extrapolated.
sentences.zh: 这些排名基于一个单一的问题，由此推导出了大量、甚至是疯狂多的内容。

sentences.en: The question is called the Cantrill Ladder.
sentences.zh: 这个问题被称为坎特里尔阶梯。

sentences.en: Here it is.
sentences.zh: 就是这样。

sentences.en: Please imagine a ladder with steps numbered from 0 at the bottom to 10 at the top.
sentences.zh: 请想象一个阶梯，底部的台阶编号为0，顶部的台阶编号为10。

sentences.en: The top of the ladder represents the best possible life for you, and the bottom of the ladder represents the worst possible life for you.
sentences.zh: 阶梯的顶部代表对你而言最好的生活，阶梯的底部代表对你而言最坏的生活。

sentences.en: On which step of the ladder would you say you personally feel you stand at this time?
sentences.zh: 你认为你个人目前处于阶梯的哪一个台阶上？

sentences.en: If, like me, your instinct upon reading the above is to draw a ladder and number the rungs as suggested, you will end up with an 11-rung ladder, which is confusing.
sentences.zh: 如果你像我一样，在阅读上述内容时的本能反应是画一个梯子并按照建议给梯级编号，你最终会得到一个11级的梯子，这会让人感到困惑。

sentences.en: The originator of the Cantrill Ladder, a psychologist named Dr. Hadley Cantrill, included a diagram of the ladder when he proposed the device in 1965.
sentences.zh: 坎特里尔阶梯的创立者、一位名叫哈德利·坎特里尔（Dr. Hadley Cantrill）的心理学家在1965年提出这个装置时，附带了一张梯子的图表。

sentences.en: The diagram clarifies that 0 is not actually a step, but refers to the space beneath the lowest rung.
sentences.zh: 该图表澄清了0实际上并不是一个台阶，而是指最低梯级下方的空间。

sentences.en: Cantrill also indicates that interviewers ought to move a finger rapidly up and down the ladder while posing the question.
sentences.zh: 坎特里尔还指出，采访者在提出问题时，应该在梯子上迅速上下移动手指。

sentences.en: Every year, representatives from Gallup contact approximately 1,000 people per country, either by phone or face-to-face, and ask them to identify their location on the ladder.
sentences.zh: 每年，盖洛普的代表通过电话或面对面联系大约每个国家1,000人，要求他们指出自己在梯子上的位置。

sentences.en: The authors of the World Happiness Report then take those answers and combine them with the answers from the previous two years, for a sample size of around 3,000 people.
sentences.zh: 《世界幸福报告》的作者随后将这些回答与前两年的回答结合起来，样本量约为3,000人。

sentences.en: Nordic countries consistently dominate the top of the liSt.
sentences.zh: 北欧国家始终占据榜首。

sentences.en: Finland has its well-publicized eight-year streak of happiness supremacy.
sentences.zh: 芬兰保持着广为人知的八年幸福至高无上纪录。

sentences.en: Denmark, Iceland, Sweden, and Norway are reliably in the top ten.
sentences.zh: 丹麦、冰岛、瑞典和挪威稳居前十。

sentences.en: The most miserable countries tend, not surprisingly, to be those stricken with poverty, conflict, corruption, and human rights violations.
sentences.zh: 毫不奇怪，最悲惨的国家往往是那些饱受贫困、冲突、腐败和侵犯人权之苦的国家。

sentences.en: Afghanistan, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Yemen, Haiti.
sentences.zh: 阿富汗、刚果民主共和国、也门、海地。

sentences.en: Between these two poles, you can see the shifting fates of nations.
sentences.zh: 在这两个极端之间，你可以看到国家命运的变迁。

sentences.en: Poland and Portugal, for example, have each ascended nearly one full ladder rung since the survey began.
sentences.zh: 例如，自调查开始以来，波兰和葡萄牙各自上升了近整整一个梯级。

sentences.en: The United States peaked at number 11 in the year 2012 and has tumbled since then.
sentences.zh: 美国在2012年达到第11位的峰值，此后便一路下跌。

sentences.en: In mid-March, the 2025 World Happiness Report was released.
sentences.zh: 3月中旬，2025年《世界幸福报告》发布。

sentences.en: It was the longest one to date, a 260-page PDF bursting with data.
sentences.zh: 这是迄今为止最长的一份报告，是一份充满数据的260页PDF。

sentences.en: The United States had dropped one spot since the previous year to 24th place.
sentences.zh: 自去年以来，美国下降了一位，跌至第24位。

sentences.en: Finland sustained its winning streak.
sentences.zh: 芬兰保持了其连胜纪录。

sentences.en: The report was pounced upon with various levels of rigor by media outlets, including this one.
sentences.zh: 包括本报在内的各大媒体都以不同程度的严谨性对这份报告进行了剖析。

sentences.en: The most surprising parts of the report slipped beneath notice.
sentences.zh: 报告中最令人惊讶的部分却悄然溜走，未受关注。

sentences.en: Would you have guessed, for example, that Italy, number 40, is apparently less happy than El Salvador, number 37?
sentences.zh: 例如，你是否会猜到，排名第40位的意大利显然没有排名第37位的萨尔瓦多快乐？

sentences.en: Or that Saudi Arabia, number 32, is happier than France, number 33?
sentences.zh: 或者排名第32位的沙特阿拉伯比排名第33位的法国更快乐？

sentences.en: Or that Israel is in the top ten?
sentences.zh: 或者以色列排在前十名？

sentences.en: Or that Bhutan, the country whose own gross national happiness index gave rise to the report, has been absent from the list since 2019, when it limped in at number 95?
sentences.zh: 或者不丹——这个因其国民幸福总指数而催生该报告的国家——自2019年以第95位的惨淡成绩勉强上榜以来，就一直缺席该榜单？

sentences.en: And then there are the raw figures.
sentences.zh: 还有原始数据。

sentences.en: Each country is ranked according to a score derived from the Cantrell ladder responses.
sentences.zh: 每个国家都是根据从坎特里尔阶梯回答中得出的分数进行排名的。

sentences.en: Finland's current score is 7.736, while the United States measures 6.724, about a ladder rung lower.
sentences.zh: 芬兰目前的分数是7.736，而美国的测量值为6.724，大约低了一个梯级。

sentences.en: If you look at it another way, Americans are 87% as happy as Finns.
sentences.zh: 从另一个角度来看，美国人的幸福度是芬兰人的87%。

sentences.en: That's not bad.
sentences.zh: 这也不算坏。

sentences.en: What seems to bother American readers about the report is that it's a game we're not winning.
sentences.zh: 美国读者对这份报告感到烦恼的似乎是，这是一场我们没有赢的游戏。

sentences.en: Indeed, it's a game we're losing to our closest neighbors, Mexico, number 10, and Canada, number 18.
sentences.zh: 事实上，这是一场我们输给我们最近的邻居——排名第10的墨西哥和排名第18的加拿大的游戏。

sentences.en: Year after year, the PDFs track our downward trajectory, past Lithuania and Slovenia, and the United Arab Emirates.
sentences.zh: 年复一年，这些PDF追踪着我们的下降轨迹，超越了立陶宛、斯洛文尼亚和阿拉伯联合酋长国。

sentences.en: If Americans are exceptional in our approach to happiness, it may have to do with an insistence on treating the matter as a glittering mystery,
sentences.zh: 如果美国人在对待幸福的方式上是独特的，那可能与坚持将这件事视为一个闪闪发光的谜团有关，

sentences.en: a thing requiring pilgrimage or a course at Harvard or Yale, both schools have offered happiness classes to understand.
sentences.zh: 一个需要朝圣或去哈佛或耶鲁上课的事情（这两所学校都开设过幸福课程来让人理解）。

sentences.en: It's a quandary we're tasked with solving, as with many quandaries in this country like taxes and health insurance and self-defense, on our own.
sentences.zh: 这是一个我们需要独自解决的难题，就像这个国家的许多难题一样，比如税收、健康保险和自卫。

sentences.en: In a land of maximal freedom, where the coffee cups are huge, we can just as easily imagine ourselves becoming billionaires or dying on a street corner.
sentences.zh: 在一个享有最大自由、咖啡杯巨大的国度里，我们可以同样轻松地想象自己成为亿万富翁或死在街角。

sentences.en: The span of the latter is as wide as our imaginations allow.
sentences.zh: 后者的跨度由我们的想象力所允许的那般广阔。

sentences.en: I'm Winnalou.
sentences.zh: 我是温娜露。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games, and I love horror movies, I love my dog, and I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我编写《纽约时报》游戏中的一个益智游戏“Connections”（拼字连线），我喜欢恐怖电影，喜欢我的狗，还喜欢试图捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·马祖尔斯基，我每天创作游戏“Spelling Bee”（拼字蜜蜂）和“Letterboxd”。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做“联觉”（promesthesia）的东西。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由真人制作的，就像你刚才听到声音的这些人一样。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问nytimes.com/games，今天就开始玩吧。

sentences.en: All government buildings in Finland have a sauna on site.
sentences.zh: 芬兰所有的政府大楼内都设有桑拿房。

sentences.en: Nationwide, there is more than one sauna for every two Finns.
sentences.zh: 在全国范围内，每两个芬兰人拥有的桑拿房数量超过一个。

sentences.en: For obvious reasons, the sauna is somewhat over-indexed in happiness tourism literature.
sentences.zh: 由于显而易见的原因，桑拿在幸福旅游文学中被某种程度上过度提及了。

sentences.en: There is a specific phrase for the blissful drowsiness associated with time spent in a heated box,
sentences.zh: 有一个特定的词汇来形容在加热的木屋中度过时间所带来的极乐困倦感，

sentences.en: Saunen Jaulkenen Raukus, and a specific elf, Sauna Tontu, thought to live between a sauna's wall and heating apparatus.
sentences.zh: 叫做Saunen Jaulkenen Raukus，还有一个特定的精灵叫Sauna Tontu，据说住在桑拿房的墙壁和加热设备之间。

sentences.en: The elf becomes angry if a sauna door is slammed.
sentences.zh: 如果用力关上桑拿房的门，这个精灵就会生气。

sentences.en: On my second day, I visited a place called Lola.
sentences.zh: 在我的第二天，我参观了一个叫Lola的地方。

sentences.en: It was my first and least representative sauna, in that it requires visitors to wear a swimsuit, irregular, costs 26 euros, expensive, and is an architectural marvel.
sentences.zh: 这是我的第一个也是最没有代表性的桑拿房，因为它要求游客穿泳衣（不寻常），花费26欧元（昂贵），并且是一个建筑奇迹。

sentences.en: A building that resembles a heap of rocks, with weathered pine planks arranged in faceted plains and concluding in a jagged terrace.
sentences.zh: 一栋酷似一堆岩石的建筑，风化的松木板排列在多面平面上，并以参差不齐的露台结束。

sentences.en: From the terrace, it was possible to walk down a set of stairs to the sea, where someone had carved a mushy, circular hole through the top layer of ice,
sentences.zh: 从露台出发，可以顺着一排楼梯走到海边，有人在最上层的冰面上凿出一个糊状的圆形洞，

sentences.en: allowing visitors to dip in the frigid water.
sentences.zh: 允许游客浸入冰冷的水中。

sentences.en: Avantooni is the word for this tradition, as I had learned from Finnish influencers on YouTube.
sentences.zh: 我从YouTube上的芬兰博主那里了解到，这种传统被称为“阿万图尼”（Avantooni）。

sentences.en: I watched the sea dippers from inside and outside the sauna, knowing what lay ahead of me.
sentences.zh: 我在桑拿房内外观察着冬泳的人群，心里清楚接下来轮到我了。

sentences.en: It was necessary to submerge.
sentences.zh: 潜入水中是必须的。

sentences.en: If I did not, the next two hours would be ruined by wondering whether or not I was capable of it.
sentences.zh: 如果不这么做，接下来的两小时我都会在怀疑自己是否有这个胆量中度过。

sentences.en: The evening air was 32 degrees Fahrenheit.
sentences.zh: 傍晚的空气只有华氏32度。

sentences.en: What was the temperature of the sea?
sentences.zh: 海水究竟有多少度呢？

sentences.en: I don't know, but aside from the sauna-dug glory hole, it plateaued as solid ice into the near distance.
sentences.zh: 我不知道，但除了那个凿开的冰窟窿之外，视线所及之处全都是厚厚的坚冰。

sentences.en: Some people leaped from the stairs without hesitation and abided for 20 or 30 seconds, giggling and gasping and treading water.
sentences.zh: 有些人毫不犹豫地从阶梯跳入水中，在里面待上20或30秒，咯咯笑着、大口喘气并踩着水。

sentences.en: Others lowered themselves from a ladder, wincing all the way.
sentences.zh: 另一些人则顺着梯子往下挪，一路上眉头紧锁。

sentences.en: Padding down the stairs, I manually shut off my brain and jumped.
sentences.zh: 踏着阶梯往下走时，我强制自己关掉大脑，纵身一跃。

sentences.en: There was a bitter taste in my mouth, as though I'd been struck by lightning, followed by a sense that my cells were being rearranged.
sentences.zh: 我的嘴里泛起一丝苦味，仿佛遭到了雷击，紧接着是一种全身细胞正在被重新排列的感觉。

sentences.en: A sauna-goer down the deck clapped.
sentences.zh: 栈桥尽头的一个桑拿客鼓起掌来。

sentences.en: The lone note of approval inflated me with enough pride that I floated a few seconds before climbing back up the ladder.
sentences.zh: 这独一无二的肯定让我充满了自豪，以至于我在爬上梯子前多漂浮了几秒钟。

sentences.en: Upon ascending the stairs, I passed a man edging his way down, and we grinned at each other, one person emerging from pointless triumph, one on his way there.
sentences.zh: 走上楼梯时，我与一个正小心翼翼往下挪的男人擦肩而过，我们相视一笑——一个刚从毫无意义的胜利中走出，另一个正朝此走去。

sentences.en: I watched the man dunk and gave a clap in turn, then hurried back indoors to the hot sauna, which made my skin feel as though it were outlined in a neon pen.
sentences.zh: 我看着那个男人完成潜水，也回敬了一记掌声，然后快步跑回室内炽热的桑拿房，这让我的皮肤感觉像被荧光笔勾勒过一般。

sentences.en: There's a line in Martin Amos' novel London Fields where the narrator reflects that we are all poets or babies in the middle of the night, struggling with being.
sentences.zh: 马丁·艾米斯（Martin Amis）的小说《伦敦菲尔兹》（London Fields）里有一句台词，讲述叙述者反思道，在半夜里我们都是诗人和婴儿，在生存的边缘挣扎。

sentences.en: So too in a frozen sea.
sentences.zh: 在冰冻的大海中也是如此。

sentences.en: But warm to the core in the sauna, you relax and have piercing thoughts such as how wonderful it is to be hot, then cold, then hot, then cold.
sentences.zh: 但在桑拿房里从里到暖，你会放松下来，并产生一些敏锐的想法，比如忽冷忽热是多么美妙的一件事。

sentences.en: The day after lowly, I visited a more typical sauna called Koti Harajun, which had a neon-red
sentences.zh: 经历过这般卑微的一天后，我参观了一家名为科蒂·哈拉容（Koti Harjun）的更典型桑拿房，它有着霓虹红色的

sentences.en: sign and two plastic chairs out front, one of them empty and the other occupied by a melancholy-seeming man in a towel.
sentences.zh: 招牌和门前的两把塑料椅子，一把空着，另一把坐着一个裹着浴巾、看上去有些忧郁的男人。

sentences.en: The man gleamed in silence, emitting heat.
sentences.zh: 那男人静静地发着光，散发着热气。

sentences.en: Through the door was a cramped vestibule with a communal freezer for guests to store beer.
sentences.zh: 推开门是一个逼仄的前厅，里面有一个供客人存放啤酒的公共冰柜。

sentences.en: An employee collected the entry fee, 16 euros, and pointed up a creaky staircase that led to the women's locker room, which a friend had described to me as a scene.
sentences.zh: 一名员工收了16欧元的门票钱，并指了指一处嘎吱作响的楼梯，通往女更衣室。一个朋友曾向我形容那里充满戏剧性。

sentences.en: It was, if quietly.
sentences.zh: 虽然很安静，但确实如此。

sentences.en: A dozen women, recently or imminently cleansed, talked softly and retrieved items from wooden lockers beside windows with sheer burgundy curtains.
sentences.zh: 十几名刚洗过澡或正准备洗澡的女性轻声交谈着，从配有浆果红半透明窗帘的木质更衣柜里拿东西。

sentences.en: There were tables and board games and a fake orchid and copies of a magazine called sauna, and industrial-sized tubs of hand sanitizer.
sentences.zh: 里面有桌子、棋盘游戏、一盆假兰花、《桑拿》杂志，以及工业大桶装的免洗手消毒液。

sentences.en: Koti Harajun had an air of utility, like a car wash or dry-cleaning service, and a faded charm.
sentences.zh: 科蒂·哈拉容透着一股实用主义的气息，就像洗车房或干洗店一样，带着一种褪色的魅力。

sentences.en: The only sign of touristic infiltration was a sauna etiquette plaque mounted on the locker room wall, outlining the basics.
sentences.zh: 唯一暴露出这里是旅游景点的迹象，是更衣室墙上挂着的一块桑拿礼仪牌，上面列出了基本规范。

sentences.en: Bathe before entering.
sentences.zh: 入内前请先沐浴。

sentences.en: Stay hydrated.
sentences.zh: 保持水分充足。

sentences.en: Don't wear perfume.
sentences.zh: 请勿使用香水。

sentences.en: Don't have loud conversations.
sentences.zh: 请勿大声喧哗。

sentences.en: Don't compete to see who can stay in the sauna longeSt.
sentences.zh: 不要比赛看谁在桑拿房里待得最久。

sentences.en: Feel free to whisk yourself and others with bundles of leafy twigs.
sentences.zh: 可以用绿叶枝条随意抽打自己和他人。

sentences.en: No other foreigners were visible in the locker room, yet everyone who knew I was going to
sentences.zh: 更衣室里看不到其他外国人，然而所有知道我要去

sentences.en: Finland had urged me to visit Koti Harajun.
sentences.zh: 芬兰的人都极力劝我一定要去科蒂·哈拉容看看。

sentences.en: With its beer freezer and neon sign, the sauna sat on a knife's edge between authentic and authentic.
sentences.zh: 凭借着啤酒冰柜和霓虹招牌，这家桑拿房在“地道”与“极致地道”的边缘反复横跳。

sentences.en: The territory between these points of awareness and overexposure is infamously narrow, and
sentences.zh: 这种全神贯注与过度曝光之间的地带出了名的狭窄，而

sentences.en: Koti Harajun seemed to have been granted long-term residency in that slender DMZ.
sentences.zh: 科蒂·哈拉容似乎在这个狭小的非军事区获得了永久居留权。

sentences.en: Unlike many Finnish treasures—heastin, cloudberry juice—the sauna is well-known beyond its borders.
sentences.zh: 与许多芬兰宝藏——比如木柴、云莓汁——不同，桑拿早已闻名遐迩。

sentences.en: America has fans, including famous ones like Joe Rogan, LeBron James, and Lady Gaga.
sentences.zh: 美国有很多爱好者，包括乔·罗根（Joe Rogan）、勒布朗·詹姆斯（LeBron James）和Lady Gaga等名人。

sentences.en: A Vanta Oni, or some version of it, has become de rigueur among fitness enthusiasts and fans of the
sentences.zh: 芬兰浴或其某种变体，已成为健身爱好者和活力论生活方式追求者的标配，

sentences.en: vitalist lifestyle, though the cold plunging in the United States is typically done solo, in a garage, possibly while you film yourself.
sentences.zh: 尽管在美国，冰浴通常是独自在车库里进行的，而且可能边做边给自己拍视频。

sentences.en: What we lack is a sauna culture, or perhaps any culture that unites us so fully.
sentences.zh: 我们所缺乏的是一种桑拿文化，或者说是一种能如此紧密凝聚我们的文化。

sentences.en: An artist I met earlier told me that her family's summer cottage had no hot water and no shower, but it did have a sauna.
sentences.zh: 我之前遇到的一位艺术家告诉我，她家的消夏小屋没有热水，也没有淋浴，但确实有桑拿房。

sentences.en: Everybody has sauna, yeah.
sentences.zh: 每个人都有桑拿，对吧。

sentences.en: Another Finn, an official at the Tourism Bureau, said that she herself wasn't a heavy sauna-goer,
sentences.zh: 另一位芬兰人、旅游局的一位官员说，她自己并不是个狂热的桑拿客，

sentences.en: only two times a week, but that if you don't have your own sauna, you will for sure have one in your building.
sentences.zh: 一周只去两次，但如果你自己没有桑拿房，你的大楼里肯定会有一个。

sentences.en: A taxi driver named Karam told me that he had a private sauna in his apartment, but that I use it only if I'm tired or sore.
sentences.zh: 一个名叫卡拉姆（Karam）的出租车司机告诉我，他的公寓里有一个私人桑拿房，但“我只有在累了或酸痛时才会用”。

sentences.en: So, every day, ha ha.
sentences.zh: 所以，每天都用，哈哈。

sentences.en: In Finland, sauna is not a means to an end.
sentences.zh: 在芬兰，桑拿并不是达到目的的手段。

sentences.en: It will not make a person richer, or more attractive, or more focused.
sentences.zh: 它不会让人变得更富有、更有吸引力或更专注。

sentences.en: The point is not to sweat out toxins, though that may occur.
sentences.zh: 重点也不是通过出汗排出毒素，尽管这可能会发生。

sentences.en: I'm not a scientiSt.
sentences.zh: 我又不是科学家。

sentences.en: The point seems to be the act itself.
sentences.zh: 重点似乎就在于这种行为本身。

sentences.en: Sitting in nude serenity among family, friends, and strangers, safe in the bone-deep sense of trust that such an idol both requires and reinforces.
sentences.zh: 在家人、朋友和陌生人中间赤诚相见、重归宁静，沉浸在那种只有这种偶像崇拜既需要又强化的、深入骨髓的信任感中。

sentences.en: The first World Happiness Report, summarizing the state of its research, drew a distinction between two concepts, affective happiness and evaluative happiness.
sentences.zh: 第一份《世界幸福报告》在总结其研究现状时，对两个概念作出了区分：情感幸福与评估幸福。

sentences.en: Effective happiness captures emotions, immediate responses to events, whether we are experiencing joy or sadness at one moment or another.
sentences.zh: 情感幸福捕捉的是情绪以及对事件的即时反应，即我们在某个时刻体验到的是快乐还是悲伤。

sentences.en: Evaluative happiness is a more contemplative or systemic matter, mapping a person's overall appraisal of life and whether they are satisfied with theirs.
sentences.zh: 评估幸福则是一个更具沉思性或系统性的问题，它映射出一个人对生活的总体评价以及他们是否对自己的生活感到满意。

sentences.en: Effective happiness is the realm of laughter, fun, picnics, parties, sex.
sentences.zh: 情感幸福属于欢笑、乐趣、野餐、派对和性爱的领域。

sentences.en: Evaluative happiness is tied to good health, sufficient income, social cohesion, safety.
sentences.zh: 评估幸福则与良好的健康、充足的收入、社会凝聚力和安全性息息相关。

sentences.en: A crude synonym for evaluative happiness, and so much of this research flounders on the crudeness of synonyms, would be contentment.
sentences.zh: 评估幸福的一个粗略同义词——很多这方面的研究都栽在了同义词的粗糙上——便是知足。

sentences.en: That is what the Cantrell ladder measures, and it should surprise no one that the Nordic
sentences.zh: 这就是坎特雷尔阶梯（Cantrell ladder）所测量的指标，北欧国家凭借其长寿、高度再分配的税收制度、高效的治理、低腐败以及共同的规范名列前茅，这应该不足为奇。

sentences.en: countries, with their long-life expectancies, highly redistributive tax regimens, functional governance, low corruption, and shared norms, land at the top of the charts.
sentences.zh: 游客们去芬兰寻找的那种幸福，甚至都不是这个国家被认为拥有的那种幸福。

sentences.en: The type of happiness that tourists go to Finland to find isn't even the sort of happiness the country is accused of possessing.
sentences.zh: 第二个容易让人产生混淆的地方在于，幸福的两个概念——情感幸福与评估幸福——可以彼此独立运作。

sentences.en: A second area of confusion is that the two concepts of happiness, affective and evaluative, can operate independent of each other.
sentences.zh: 一个正在分娩的女性可能会遭受阵痛，这意味着她的情感幸福度低，但她会感到深深的满足或充满目标感，即评估幸福度高。

sentences.en: A woman in the midst of extruding a baby might suffer from labor pains, low affective happiness, but feel profoundly satisfied or purposeful, high evaluative happiness.
sentences.zh: 世界上最幸福国家的标签似乎在美式思维中烙下了“无尽欢乐旋转木马”的印象，但在芬兰二月的严寒中，现实要朴素得多。

sentences.en: The happiest country in the world label seems to imprint on the American mind as a never-ending carousel of delights, but in Finland's February chill, the reality is more modeSt.
sentences.zh: 一天早晨，我登上了一辆有轨电车并闭上眼睛，一部分是因为困倦，一部分是为了倾听。

sentences.en: One morning, I boarded a trolley and closed my eyes, partly in sleepiness and partly to listen.
sentences.zh: 芬兰语属于乌拉尔语系的芬兰-乌戈尔语族，匈牙利语和爱沙尼亚语也属于这一语族。

sentences.en: Finnish belongs to the Finno-Ugric family, to which Hungarian and Estonian also belong.
sentences.zh: 它有一种起伏的音律感。

sentences.en: It has an undulant sound.
sentences.zh: 在电车上，我想到了海浪的顶峰以及沿着钟乳石蜿蜒而下的晶莹水滴。

sentences.en: On the trolley, I thought of ocean waves cresting and crystalline droplets wending down stalactites.
sentences.zh: 这种解读或许受到了这个国家流水景观——湖泊、河流、大海——丰富的印记影响，或者说这门语言本身就在某种程度上被水景所浸润。

sentences.en: This interpretation may have been flavored by the nation's abundance of water features,
sentences.zh: 亦或是这种联想归因于芬兰语的语调模式，它在一句话的过程中从高音降到低音。

sentences.en: lakes, rivers, sea, or perhaps the language itself had somehow been flavored by the water features.
sentences.zh: 由于重音总是落在一个词的第一个音节上，这门语言还具有一种舒适的规律感，就像马蹄在路上得得作响。

sentences.en: Or the association might have owed to Finnish intonation patterns, which cascade from high to low pitch over the course of a sentence.
sentences.zh: 我在市中心下了车，步行前往赫尔辛基的主图书馆，它看起来像一艘胡萝卜蛋糕做成的船。

sentences.en: Because the stress is always on a word's first syllable, the language also has a cozy regularity, like a horse clopping down a road.
sentences.zh: 它叫奥迪（Oodi）。

sentences.en: I got off at the city center and walked to Helsinki's main library, which looks like a ship made of carrot cake.
sentences.zh: 这个名字是从2018年图书馆开业前几年举办的一个征名比赛的2600个条目中遴选出来的。

sentences.en: It is called Odie.
sentences.zh: 评审团希望找一个简短、易读且不以个人命名的图书馆名字。

sentences.en: The name was selected from 2,600 entries in a competition held a couple years before the library opened in 2018.
sentences.zh: “Oodi”在芬兰语中是“颂歌”的意思。

sentences.en: The jury sought a library name that was short, easy to pronounce, and not dedicated to a single person.
sentences.zh: 访客从这艘巨大的胡萝卜蛋糕船的船头进入，如果脚上穿着冰爪，会被提醒脱掉冰爪。

sentences.en: Odie is Finnish for Ode.
sentences.zh: 我到达的那天早上，里面人头攒动却一片寂静，视觉上的繁杂与四周的安静交织在一起，

sentences.en: A visitor enters through the prow of the enormous carrot cake ship and is prompted to remove her ice cleats, if she is wearing them.
sentences.zh: 让我感觉自己仿佛戴上了降噪耳机。

sentences.en: It was thronged but quiet on the morning I arrived, and the disorienting combination of visual traffic with hushedness
sentences.zh: “嗨，”一名员工打招呼道。

sentences.en: made me feel as though I were wearing noise-canceling headphones.
sentences.zh: “嗨，”我回应道。

sentences.en: Hey, an employee said in greeting.
sentences.zh: “门票多少钱？”

sentences.en: Hey, I said.
sentences.zh: “什么？”

sentences.en: What is the cost of a ticket?
sentences.zh: “我要买票才能进吗？”

sentences.en: What?
sentences.zh: “哈哈哈哈，”那名员工笑了起来。

sentences.en: Shall I buy a ticket to enter?
sentences.zh: “不，我们没有门票。”

sentences.en: Ha ha ha, the employee said.
sentences.zh: “哈哈，没有门票，当然没有。”

sentences.en: No, we don't have tickets.
sentences.zh: 进公共图书馆根本不需要门票。

sentences.en: Ha ha, no ticket, of course.
sentences.zh: 这座建筑的奢华触发了某种想要付出金钱的条件反射，而这本身就在内心里激起了一丝阴霾。

sentences.en: One does not need a ticket to enter a public library.
sentences.zh: 图书馆的一楼有一间电影院、一家供应甜菜千层面和胡萝卜汤的自助餐厅，还有22名儿童正坐在靠窗的桌子旁下国际象棋。

sentences.en: The fanciness of the building had tripped some reflex to sacrifice cash, which itself caused an inner ripple of gloom.
sentences.zh: 我上了二楼，那里设有一个3D打印工位、一台激光切割机、一台大幅面打印机、一台雕刻机、供任何人使用的会议室，

sentences.en: On the ground floor of the library was a cinema, a cafeteria serving beet lasagna and carrot soup, and 22 children playing games of chess at window-side tables.
sentences.zh: 以及供人坐着阅读的摇椅。

sentences.en: I escalated to the second floor, which featured a 3D printing station, a laser cutter, a large-format printer, an engraving machine, conference rooms for anyone to use,
sentences.zh: 这里有可供借阅的优质电吉他和木吉他、一套架子鼓和多把齐特琴、一个播客工作室、一个电子音乐工作室、

sentences.en: and rocking chairs in which to sit and read.
sentences.zh: 教室，以及一个可以预订用来和朋友一起烹饪的厨房空间。

sentences.en: There were electric and acoustic guitars, nice ones, to borrow, as well as a drum kit and multiple zithers, a podcast studio, an electronic music studio,
sentences.zh: 这一切都令人着迷，但真正让我屏息凝神的，是一块标牌。

sentences.en: classrooms, a kitchen space that could be reserved for cooking with friends.
sentences.zh: 在布鲁克林的家中，图书馆里到处贴满了提醒人们“请保持低声”的便条。

sentences.en: All of this was enchanting, but it was a piece of signage that took my breath away.
sentences.zh: 与此相反，奥迪的标牌写的是：“请让其他人安心工作。”

sentences.en: At home in Brooklyn, the library is papered with reminders to please keep your voice down.
sentences.zh: 这两条命令几乎是同义的，但在意义上却大不相同。

sentences.en: In contradistinction, the signs at Odie said, please let others work in peace.
sentences.zh: 布鲁克林的版本是对自我控制的恳求。

sentences.en: The two commands are almost, but meaningfully not, synonymous.
sentences.zh: 芬兰的版本则是承认他人存在的请求。

sentences.en: The Brooklyn version is a plea for self-control.
sentences.zh: 你看出区别了吧。

sentences.en: The Finnish version is a request to acknowledge the existence of other people.
sentences.zh: 顶楼摆放着书籍、游戏以及爱德华·格里格（Edvard Grieg）和雅尼（Yanni）等作曲家的乐谱。

sentences.en: You see the difference.
sentences.zh: 这里有第二家咖啡馆，更多的三文鱼汤、粉顶公主蛋糕，每张桌子上都摆着插有鲜花的玻璃罐。

sentences.en: On the top floor were books, games, and sheet music from composers like Edvard Grieg and Yanni.
sentences.zh: 室内生长着榕树，阳光温柔地穿过弧形的玻璃墙。

sentences.en: There was a second cafe, more salmon soup, pink-domed princess cakes, and glass jars of fresh flowers at every table.
sentences.zh: 墙外矗立着拥有雄伟灰色外立面的议会大厦。

sentences.en: Bushida Bucerus trees grew indoors, sunshine pressed gently through curved glass walls.
sentences.zh: 据图书馆手册介绍，奥迪的露台设计得与议会大厦的入口处于完全相同的高度，象征着民主与对话。

sentences.en: Beyond the walls stood the House of Parliament with its mighty gray facade.
sentences.zh: 赤脚的孩子们从倾斜的云杉木地板上滚下来，仿佛那是一座长满青草的山坡。

sentences.en: The Odie balcony was designed to rest at precisely the same level as the entrance to the house, to symbolize democracy and dialogue, according to a library brochure.
sentences.zh: 停下来想一想，在美国的一个大城市里，有一座干净到可以在地板上打滚的公共图书馆，这是多么荒诞不经的事。

sentences.en: Children in stocking feet rolled down a sloping spruce floor as though it were a grassy hill.
sentences.zh: 看着他们在波浪状的天花板下嬉戏，我再次感到了深深的悲伤。

sentences.en: Pause to contemplate the far-fetchedness of a public library in a major U.S.
sentences.zh: 这里呈现了一种人类蓬勃发展的愿景，它既简单又不可思议。

sentences.en: city that is clean enough for floor rolling.
sentences.zh: 我还记得小时候在旧金山，走进一家公共图书馆时无意中听到一个人开了这样一个玩笑：“就流浪汉收容所而言，这地方书还真不少。”

sentences.en: Watching them frolic beneath a wavy egg of ceiling, I became, once again, very sad.
sentences.zh: 如果认为奥迪没有发挥收容所的功能，那就大错特错了。

sentences.en: Here was a vision of human flourishing that was simultaneously simple and inconceivable.
sentences.zh: 这里有一些携带大量随身物品的人，把这个空间当成恒温的睡眠庇护所。

sentences.en: As a kid in San Francisco, I remember walking into a public library and overhearing a man crack the following joke, for a homeless shelter, this place sure has a lot of books.
sentences.zh: 这是被允许的。

sentences.en: It would be a mistake, not to mention that Odie performed a shelter function too.
sentences.zh: 这些睡觉的人并没有被限制在任何特定的区域。

sentences.en: There were people with an unusual volume of possessions using the space as a temperature-controlled sleeping enclosure.
sentences.zh: 他们既没有被回避，也没有被骚扰。

sentences.en: It was allowed.
sentences.zh: 如果这就是芬兰人眼中的地板——坎特雷尔阶梯上的零分或接近零分，那么天花板在某些轴线上也相当低，这又有什么大不了的呢？

sentences.en: The sleepers weren't confined to any particular section.
sentences.zh: 这些高大、头发浓密的芬兰人中有谁会环顾他们的图书馆并心想：“我的国家缺少的是杰夫·贝佐斯（Jeff Bezos）或成为他的这种虚幻机会吗？”

sentences.en: They were neither avoided nor harassed.
sentences.zh: 或许仅仅是没有这种想法，就能让你在阶梯上往上走一步。

sentences.en: If that was a Finn's idea of the floor, zero on the cantrill or close to it, how much did it matter that the ceiling was also, along certain axes, rather low?
sentences.zh: 在与一位朋友发短信的过程中，我提到自己极其沮丧。

sentences.en: Did any of these tall, thick-haired Finnish people look around their library and think, what my country lacks is Jeff Bezos or the delusion of the opportunity to become him?
sentences.zh: 她打了电话过来，一直打到我回拨过去，这正是一个好朋友会做的事。我语无伦次地倾诉着看到芬兰儿童游荡玩耍时的悲伤，

sentences.en: Perhaps the absence of that thought alone moves you one step up the ladder.
sentences.zh: 并告诉她，图书馆里各种年龄的母亲们自发聚集在一起聊天、休息或漫不经心地按摩着双脚。

sentences.en: In the course of a text conversation with a friend, I mentioned that I was exceedingly glum.
sentences.zh: 我解释说，其中一位母亲将她的宝宝——一个不超过九个月大的孩子——放在图书馆咖啡桌的高脚椅上，

sentences.en: She called, and kept calling until I called back, which is what a good friend does, and I rambled about my sorrow at watching the Finnish children rove and play,
sentences.zh: 递给他一罐蔬菜泥让他自己琢磨，然后就离开20分钟去挑书了。

sentences.en: and told her about how mothers of all ages gathered spontaneously in the library to chat or rest or idly massage their feet.
sentences.zh: 她回来时，我们相视一笑。

sentences.en: I explained that one of these mothers had placed her baby, a child of no more than nine months, in a high chair at a library cafe table
sentences.zh: 她问我从哪里来。

sentences.en: and handed him a vegetable puree to consider, then left for 20 minutes to fetch books.
sentences.zh: 我说：“纽约。”

sentences.en: When she came back, we exchanged smiles.
sentences.zh: “我有个小女孩，大概和你儿子一般大。”

sentences.en: She asked where I was visiting from.
sentences.zh: “啊，我还没去过纽约呢。”

sentences.en: New York, I said.
sentences.zh: “我很想去。”

sentences.en: I have a little girl about your son's age.
sentences.zh: 我们聊起了孩子、图书馆以及我们各自国家的相对安全系数。

sentences.en: Ah, I haven't been to New York yet.
sentences.zh: 她谈到芬兰时说：“每隔几年会发生一次婴儿被偷的危机，但15分钟后就会被找回或归还。”

sentences.en: I would like to go.
sentences.zh: 没什么大不了的。

sentences.en: We talked about children and libraries and the relative safety of our nations.
sentences.zh: 她的儿子吃完了蔬菜泥，他们挥手告别，去探索童话墙了。

sentences.en: Every few years, there's a crisis where a baby is stolen, but then it is returned or found 15 minutes later, she said of Finland.
sentences.zh: 旅行具有让家乡变得陌生的效力，许多关于芬兰的事，我只有通过将它们与家乡的现状进行对比才能了解到。

sentences.en: Nothing severe.
sentences.zh: 从远处看，我在纽约认为令人讨厌但又互不相干的行为，凝聚成了一个暴露出自私与冷漠混合体的类别。

sentences.en: Her son finished his puree, and they waved goodbye, off to explore the fairy tale wall.
sentences.zh: 乱扔垃圾、堵住地铁门、占用两个停车位、对一个正费劲把孩子推车抬上或抬下楼梯的母亲视而不见。

sentences.en: Travel has the effect of defamiliarizing one's home, and there were many things I learned about Finland only by comparing them with the status quo back home.
sentences.zh: 人们出于各种各样的原因做出反社会行为。

sentences.en: From afar, actions I had considered annoying but unrelated in New York congealed into a category betraying a mixture of selfishness and cynicism.
sentences.zh: 我无法在短短一周内弄明白，为什么芬兰人不抗拒他们那小小的咖啡杯，不乱扔垃圾，不插队，不在公共场所大声打电话，

sentences.en: Littering, blocking subway doors, taking up two parking spaces, ignoring a mother struggling to hoist her kid's stroller up or down a flight of stairs.
sentences.zh: 为什么虽然每五个人里就有一个养狗，却看不到狗的粪便。

sentences.en: People behave antisocially for all kinds of reasons.
sentences.zh: 或者为什么如果人行横道灯是红色的，

sentences.en: I could not, in the space of a week, discover why Finns did not rebel against their tiny coffee cups, or litter, or cut in line, or carry out loud cell phone conversations
sentences.zh: 芬兰人会一直等到灯闪烁绿光才过马路，即使两个方向都完全没有驶来的车辆。

sentences.en: in public places, or why there was no visible dog waste, although some one in five of them owns a dog.
sentences.zh: 我向电话那头的朋友喋喋不休地抱怨着，一想到我的女儿永远无法独自在图书馆里吃蔬菜，

sentences.en: Or why, if a crosswalk light is red,
sentences.zh: 或者在室内树下的童话墙上画北极光，我就感到十分痛苦。

sentences.en: Finns will wait until the light blinks green to cross, even if there is zero oncoming traffic in either direction.
sentences.zh: 备用占位符

sentences.en: On and on I complained to my friend on the phone, wretched about the idea that my daughter would never eat vegetables alone in a library,
sentences.zh: 备用占位符

sentences.en: or paint northern lights on a fairy tale wall beneath an indoor tree.
sentences.zh: 备用占位符

sentences.en: True, said my friend, but there are worse places to raise a kid than in the United States.
sentences.zh: “确实，”我的朋友说，“但在美国把孩子抚养长大，也算不上最糟糕的地方。”

sentences.en: She was correct.
sentences.zh: 她说得没错。

sentences.en: Romania, Kosovo, and Estonia among them, at least according to the World Happiness Report.
sentences.zh: 罗马尼亚、科索沃和爱沙尼亚都在其中，至少根据《世界幸福报告》是这样的。

sentences.en: A week-long fixation on the Cantrell ladder was warping any sense of proportion.
sentences.zh: 对坎特雷尔阶梯长达一周的执念，扭曲了任何对比例的感觉。

sentences.en: The next day, I departed the most life-satisfied country on Earth in a Finnair plane that hiccuped queasily until it reached cruising altitude.
sentences.zh: 第二天，我乘坐一架芬兰航空公司的飞机离开了这个地球上生活满意度最高国家，飞机在爬升到巡航高度之前，一直令人恶心地颠簸着。

sentences.en: What awaited me back in New York?
sentences.zh: 回到纽约有什么在等着我？

sentences.en: First, there would be the airport taxi line, a reliable case study in misanthropy, then a slow journey home on potholed expressways to an apartment with holes in the floor.
sentences.zh: 首先是机场的出租车队，这是反人类心理的绝佳案例，接着是沿着布满坑洼的高速公路缓缓回家，回到一间地板上有洞的公寓。

sentences.en: Medical bills.
sentences.zh: 医疗账单。

sentences.en: Daycare bills.
sentences.zh: 托儿所账单。

sentences.en: On the other hand, large coffee cups.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，有大杯的咖啡。

sentences.en: All tourism starts out as happiness tourism.
sentences.zh: 所有的旅行，最初都是幸福旅行。

sentences.en: There are other words we use when we travel to visit family, conduct business, or elude capture, even if it mutates into a voyage of morbid introspection.
sentences.zh: 当我们去探亲、出差或潜逃时，我们会用其他的词来形容，即使它最终演变成了一场病态的自我审视之旅。

sentences.en: During that first meeting with Miko Tirunen, I posed to him the Cantrell ladder question.
sentences.zh: 在与米科·蒂鲁宁的第一次会面中，我向他提出了坎特雷尔阶梯的问题。

sentences.en: Like every fin I would go on to ask, he refused to indulge its premise.
sentences.zh: 就像我之后问过的每一位芬兰人一样，他拒绝顺应这个前提。

sentences.en: How would I know the answer?
sentences.zh: 我怎么会知道答案？

sentences.en: Tirunen said.
sentences.zh: 蒂鲁宁说。

sentences.en: I'm only having this one life.
sentences.zh: 我只有这一生。

sentences.en: No ladder.
sentences.zh: 没有阶梯。

sentences.en: No top.
sentences.zh: 没有顶端。

sentences.en: And no bottom.
sentences.zh: 也没有底端。

sentences.en: There was darkness.
sentences.zh: 曾经是一片黑暗。

sentences.en: Now something is happening.
sentences.zh: 现在有什么事情正在发生。

sentences.en: And I'm confused.
sentences.zh: 而我感到很困惑。

sentences.en: And then there will be darkness again.
sentences.zh: 然后将再次陷入黑暗。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直像一个受到严密控制的机器一样运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当时选举迎来了群自称改革派的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 自那以后，该党一直陷入一场残酷、混乱、有时又令人兴奋的斗争之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me,
sentences.zh: 在最新一期的《都市》节目中，我是主持人

sentences.en: Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 莎拉·凯尼格，这里讲述的是人们试图维持影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《都市》。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 在您获取播客的任何地方收听。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 在您获取播客的任何地方收听。
